facts.fact: Nation Online reports that Section 12 of the elections Act makes the national ID from the National Registration Bureau the sole proof of eligibility for voter registration, which the High Court upheld on 25 October 2024.
facts.system: Presidential, Parliamentary and Local Government Elections Act s.12

MWI.note: Whether the roll is digital is not stated.
12.5 million registered is stated with no population or share.
No operation or maintenance of the ID system stated.

facts.fact: Nation Online reports that voter registration by the Malawi Electoral Commission requires the national ID issued by the National Registration Bureau as sole proof of eligibility, under Section 12 of the elections Act.
The National Registration Bureau says it has registered 12.5 million people, and the court directed it to register eligible voters for IDs and give them a unique identifier.
